rules.statement: Section 289 of the Civil Procedure Code does not override the provisions of section 238; a bona fide private alienee is statim securus if the seizure has not been registered.
rules.supporting_quote: "If the seizure is not registered, the necessary implication of section 238 is that a bona fide private alienee is statim securus. Section 289, as regards relation back, must be read in the light of section 238, and its operation should not be extended to a case where the seizure has not been registered."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 289 of the Civil Procedure Code or null

meta.parties: Hendrick Singho v. Kalanis Appu Et Al
